title: Zenji recipe sibling hunt — permissionless rebalance valued and floored by the same Curve pool
closed_reasons: Zenji wstETH vault: loanExists=false, debt=0, strategy balanceOf=0, StakeDAO LP=0; rebalance() reverts RebalanceNotNeeded() 0x5121f343; only 0.009065059159379702 wstETH of holder-owned dust remains
Zenji WBTC vault: same state; 0.00183694 WBTC dust
Zenji pmUSD-era vaults: totalAssets=0 and totalSupply=0, never funded
Extra Finance: all three keeper switches false and caller-whitelisted (Error(string) "20" = VL_LIQUIDATOR_NOT_IN_WHITELIST); minOut is caller-supplied
Contango V2: no on-chain liquidation entry point; trade/close is owner-or-approved (Unauthorised(address))
Extrafi XLend MetaMorpho: allocate/reallocate allocator-only and priced on Morpho oracle, no LP leg
Gearbox v3: liquidation priced by IPriceOracleV3, not by a pool the caller trades; no vault-level permissionless rebalance
Fluid Lite (ex-Instadapp Lite): rebalance modules are onlyRebalancer
YieldBasis: no keeper rebalance entry point (mint/redeem only; leverage adjusted by users), 11 live LT markets
Curvance: money market, no leveraged LP vault with a keeper path
LlamaLend leverage wrappers: stateless zaps, no funds and no keeper path
Beefy / Yearn v3 / StakeDAO CLM controls: permissionless harvest/report but no debt and no pool-derived LTV (fail tests b and c)
key_facts: Historical exploit reproduced from scratch: independent attacker contract at fork block 26371412 flash-borrows 7,237,500 USDT from Morpho Blue, buys 7,138,299.911635911250934175 crvUSD in Curve StableNG 0x390f…7BF4, calls rebalance() on both Zenji vaults, sells the crvUSD back and nets +4,951.395691 USDT — identical to the on-chain attacker's 4,951,395,691 units

Attacker's real tx: 0x79fa5b304186be7eaa19a59f57b82e1fa942afee92da45ae73afe27ee817d701, block 26,371,413, 6,792,575 gas, executed in the attacker contract constructor; proceeds later sent to the Tornado router 0xd90e2f…f31b

Three tests all pass on deployed code: rebalance() is external with no role; strategy balanceOf() = min(cached get_virtual_price, calc_withdraw_one_coin(lp, crvUSD)) from the same pool; _removeLiquidity derives minOut from that same calc_withdraw_one_coin quote (vault maxSlippage 1%)
Attack size is capped by the pool's crvUSD inventory (7.19M at the exploit block, 7.99M at block 26,381,000): 10M and 14M buys revert
Historical size sweep at block 26371412: 1M -199, 2.5M -499, 5M -999, 7.2375M +4,951, 10M revert, 14M revert (USDT units)

Live dust: vault A 0.009065059159379702 wstETH ($24.07) + vault B 0.00183694 WBTC ($137.68) = $161.74 at wstETH $2,654.78 / WBTC $74,941.92 (DefiLlama 2026-11-10); holder-redeemable, not attacker-extractable

Latent re-arm quantified on a simulated 100 wstETH ($238k) third-party deposit: +$15,136 at 8.0M flash with no price move (NAV -6.3%); +$69,082 at 8.2M and +$143,799 at 8.8M after a mocked -10% wstETH move (NAV -29.9% / -71.3%)
Both vaults still accept deposits (depositsPaused=false, emergencyMode=false, depositCap=0) and the deployed strategies are immutable and unpatched; only the GitHub source was hardened

Fleet enumeration: 4 Zenji vaults from the deployer's 30 creations after block 25.2M; Rebalance(uint256,uint256,bool) topic0 0xd2412c66…383d returns 93 logs from exactly 2 addresses; DefiLlama erc4626 registry lists the same 2; no public fork of the Zenji repo

Independent ETH-lane confirmation: the two additional Zenji pmUSD-era vaults 0xB415bce7…c31F (ZenjiWbtcLlamaStakeDao) and 0x45bBa5E1…1595 (ZenjiWstEthLlamaStakeDao) are exact-code siblings that pass all three tests but hold $0 (totalSupply=0); rebalance() from 0x…dEaD reverts RebalanceNotNeeded() and harvestYield() succeeds

Strongest funded near-miss: Fluid Lite iETHv2 0xA0D3707c…Be78 holds $148.9M (70,077.77 stETH) but every rebalance path is onlyRebalancer (eth_call revert 0x78fb3fe5 = Helpers__NotRebalancer()) and NAV is a stored exchangePrice checkpoint, not pool spot

YieldBasis: 11 live LT markets, $93.08M protocol equity, but no rebalance/delever/harvest selector; valuation uses a bounded price_scale EMA plus LEVAMM invariant, and the only permissionless protocol trade is distribute_borrower_fees() (~$1,809 of accrued interest protocol-wide, donated back to LPs)
Gearbox v3: $19.38M protocol / $7.46M wstETH debt; liquidateCreditAccount is public but priced by Chainlink feeds with staleness checks, so it cannot be moved by a DEX skew

Extra Finance (OP/Base $8.21M + $0.50M TVL): all three keeper switches false and caller-whitelisted, all funded Base vaults frozen, borrowEnabled=false on every funded vault; minOut is caller-supplied in the close structs
Contango V2 ($9.32M Arb + $0.76M Base + $0.36M OP): no on-chain liquidation function; trade/close requires owner or isApprovedForAll (Unauthorised(address))
caveats: Latent table uses vm.mockCall on the Chainlink wstETH/USD feed to simulate a -10% collateral drawdown and a `deal`-funded 100 wstETH deposit on a fork; it measures what a returning depositor would expose, not a live position, and is excluded from the E-U headline

Latent profitability is non-monotonic and pool-state dependent: 8.2M and 8.8M lose money on a healthy vault while 8.0M profits; sizes outside the window revert or lose, so the range is a bound, not a guaranteed yield

L2/ETH sibling verdicts rely on verified source plus behavioural eth_call probes at the stated blocks; Extra Finance's OP/Base bytecode is unverified (flag/field-name inference marked as such in the child report)
USD values are point-in-time (DefiLlama 2026-11-10); USDT/crvUSD are treated at ~$1
No mainnet transactions were sent; the fork suite is the only execution path
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live: the only contracts implementing the Zenji recipe are its own 4 vaults — 2 drained to $161.74 of holder dust (no loan, no LP, keeper reverts RebalanceNotNeeded) and 2 never funded; the recipe itself is fork-proven at +4,951.40 USDT and re-arms on any future deposit (latent $15.1k-$143.8k per tx on a simulated $238k vault).
